attrs.model_target:
SOCAT v2022 fugacity of CO2 with the atmospheric fCO2 removed as well as the 
explainable thermal components -> diffxco2_fco2nonT = fco2socat - xco2mbl - (fco2clim * 0.0423 * deltaT).
fco2atm was calculated from NOAA xCO2 MBL (2022) + MSLP ERA5 + SST + SSS; recent years.
for where the xCO2 MBL is missing regresses xCO2 MBL with xCO2 Mauna Loa data. 
Filter criteria: (diffxco2_fco2nonT > 200), (diffxco2_fco2nonT < -250), (ice < 0.85)
